UltraModern Technologies Pvt Ltd. is a professional IT company based in Indore, India.

We provide high-quality digital solutions for businesses including startups, small businesses, and enterprises.

Our core services include:

- Website Design & Development
- Software Development
- Mobile App Development (Android & iOS)
- SEO Services (Local SEO & Global SEO)
- Digital Marketing Services
- Google Ads / PPC Campaign Management
- Social Media Marketing (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn)
- UI/UX Design Services
- CRM Software Development
- IT Consulting Services
- E-commerce Website Development
- AI & Automation Solutions

Our software products:

- Smart Campus ERP: school, college and coaching management (admissions, attendance, exams, online tests, LMS, fees, transport with live bus tracking, student and parent portals, AI assistant). https://www.ultramoderntechnologies.com/products/smart-campus-erp
- MediCare Hospital ERP: hospital management with one panel per department (OPD/IPD, OT, ICU, laboratory, pharmacy, billing, insurance claims, HR payroll, ambulance, blood bank). https://www.ultramoderntechnologies.com/products/medicare-hospital-erp
- Smart AI CRM: CRM with bulk WhatsApp, SMS and IVR, an AI bot and shared inbox, workflow automation, Ads Manager and HR payroll. https://www.ultramoderntechnologies.com/products/smart-ai-crm
- Transport Management ERP: bookings and quotes, fleet and driver compliance, trip scheduling, live GPS tracking, proof of delivery, invoices, fuel and maintenance, with driver and customer panels. https://www.ultramoderntechnologies.com/products/transport-erp
- Gym Management Software: memberships and payments, front-desk check-in, group classes with waitlists, coach sessions, workout plans and member progress tracking. https://www.ultramoderntechnologies.com/products/gym-management
All products: https://www.ultramoderntechnologies.com/products
